candidates.name: Shanghai Dachang

source_notes.title: Chinese Wikipedia: Shanghai Dachang Airport
source_notes.note: The Chinese-language article identifies Shanghai Dachang Airbase as a military airfield, gives opened as 1938, says it was built by Japanese forces during the invasion, later taken over by the Republic of China Air Force, then by the PLA after 1949, and managed by PLA Naval Aviation from March 1953.

source_notes.title: China Aerospace Studies Institute: PLAN Special Mission Aviation Air Base Renovation and Expansion Activities
source_notes.note: CASI says Shanghai Dachang Air Base underwent renovation and expansion beginning in late 2021 and finishing sometime in late 2022, and identifies it as likely home garrison of the Eastern Theater Navy special mission aviation division.

source_notes.title: Mindat/GeoNames feature 11493767: Shanghai Dachang
source_notes.note: Mindat mirrors the GeoNames feature ID, Shanghai Dachang name, airbase class, and queue coordinates.

candidates.rationale: Use 1938 only as a low-confidence opening year because the date comes from an encyclopedia entry rather than an official facility history. CASI's 2021-2022 renovation evidence independently supports continued airbase use but does not establish the original start date.
